The '''Truffle''' is a type of mushroom that can only be spawned by an adult [[Pig]] on [[The Farm]] when the pig is outside the [[Barn]]. Since pigs do not go out of the barn in winter, they spawn no truffles in that season. It can also be dropped from [[Truffle Crab]]s. It may also randomly appear at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{tprice|625}}.

Despite being spawned by pigs, truffles are not considered to be animal products, like eggs or milk. They do not receive a price increase from the [[Farming#Farming Skill|Rancher]] profession.

Despite being mushrooms, Truffles technically are also not considered to be [[Foraging|foraged]] items, but give Foraging XP when picked up on the farm. They are not among the items included in the foraging category at the [[Stardew Valley Fair]], nor are they labeled as "Forage" in [[inventory]]. They do, however, benefit from the [[Skills#Foraging|Gatherer]] and [[Skills#Foraging|Botanist]] professions. Truffles and [[Red Mushroom]] are also the only mushrooms that cannot be placed into a [[Dehydrator]].

Truffles not gathered on the 28th day of a season disappear on the following morning, the 1st day of the new season.

==Recipes==
Truffle is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Truffle can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Tailoring|Dark Bandana Shirt]].  [[File:Shirt262a.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
*The Truffle may be randomly requested during any season at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|1875}} and 150 [[Friendship]] points. The Truffle will never be requested unless the player owns a [[Pig]].
